intervention_label: Comprehensive tumour DNA plus RNA panel (IDH1 codon 132, IDH2 codons 140/172, TMB, MSI, fusions) on macrodissected dedifferentiated tissue - diagnostic gate
expected_benefit: One order resolves IDH1/IDH2 status against a 71% pre-test probability in dedifferentiated disease versus 36% in conventional (pmid:36926116), plus TMB, MSI and CDK-pathway status. Those results are what gate the abemaciclib seat (NCT04040205), TAPUR entry (NCT02693535) and the tumour-agnostic pembrolizumab route.
key_risks: No procedural risk; the panel rides archival diagnostic tissue and waits for no operation.

Turnaround runs 2-3 weeks on the comprehensive panel and 3-10 days for a targeted IDH hotspot assay, against a disease whose metastatic medians run 5-7 months (pmid:17720491, pmid:37174084). First-line treatment must not wait for the report.

Sequencing the cartilaginous rather than the dedifferentiated component answers a question about a clone that may no longer be driving anything, so macrodissection and a stated sampled lesion belong on the requisition.
Mutant IDH1 is recurrently lost during metastatic evolution (pmid:41299743), so a call on the acetabular primary may not describe the lung nodules.
preference_alignment: matches 'wants to pursue all possible therapeutic options': YES - a single order opens or closes the IDH axis, the named-histology abemaciclib seat, TAPUR entry and the tumour-agnostic checkpoint route at once. matches prefers_trials (true): YES; the panel is what every genotype-matched protocol screens on first. No toxicity veto to hit, since the veto list is empty.
guideline_status: No category asserted. concensusite could not read NCCN Bone Cancer v2.2025 (pmid:40203873) or the ESMO-EURACAN bone sarcoma guideline (pmid:34500044) beyond their abstracts, and declined to claim either lists IDH testing in the chondrosarcoma workup algorithm.
rationale_summary: Four of five personas ranked this and all four gave it their highest confidence in the case; it is the only move on the board with no safety cost. A positive IDH call does not open NCT06127407 or NCT04278781, both of which exclude dedifferentiated histology by name, and the only published IDH-inhibitor figure in her subtype is olutasidenib at a median PFS of 1.5 months (pmid:41895355) against ivosidenib's 23.1%, which belongs to 13 conventional-histology patients (pmid:40100120). The ivosidenib conversation a positive call opens is filed once, on the Standard-of-care table: NCCN carries IDH inhibitors for IDH-mutant dedifferentiated disease, guideline carriage decides the filing under the two-table contract, and concensusite's pre-commitment against off-label use outside a trial travels with it there, gated on this panel. The risktaker declined to rank the order, arguing that the glutaminase route does not wait on the IDH result because cell-line sensitivity did not sort by genotype (pmid:29576625); that objection narrows the claim rather than defeating it. The access tag reads standard care because the assay is a routine clinical order; the row sits here because the gating contract puts the confirmatory workup at rank 1 of this table, not because the panel is an experimental therapy. Every persona attached the same operational condition: the report must state which lesion was sampled, and nothing about first-line chemotherapy should wait for it.
open_questions: Whether the archival diagnostic block contains enough dedifferentiated component for macrodissection, or whether a re-biopsy or the operative specimen is needed.
Whether an IDH result should be repeated on a metastatic specimen, given recurrent loss of mutant IDH1 during metastatic evolution (pmid:41299743).
MMR IHC, PD-L1 on the dedifferentiated component, B7-H3 H-score and allele-level HLA class I typing are separate, parallel gates carried as open questions on the rows they govern.
likelihood_of_effect: Diagnostic gate, not therapy: 71% pre-test probability for IDH in dedifferentiated disease (pmid:36926116), but a positive call buys trial currency rather than expected benefit.
toxicity_burden: Low (none - assay on archival tissue)
overall: One block, one order: the panel opens or closes the IDH axis, the abemaciclib seat, TAPUR entry and the checkpoint route, and it must not delay chemotherapy.

intervention_label: IACS-6274 (glutaminase-1 inhibitor), phase 1 NCT05039801 - make the screening call now, enroll only on informed choice
expected_benefit: No glutaminase inhibitor has a reported response in any chondrosarcoma patient anywhere. What this row buys concretely is a screening answer from the one open protocol in the whole screen that writes chondrosarcoma into Part A dose escalation as its own population, with no prior-therapy requirement.
key_risks: Dose escalation means she could be assigned a dose level nobody involved expects to work.
Entry requires ECOG 0-1 with no deterioration over the preceding fortnight, so the assumed 2 has to be measured, and measured down, before a screening visit is worth booking.
Single-site protocol in Houston; her travel tolerance was never discussed.
Taking a first-line phase 1 monotherapy slot would spend her one window of proven response on a dose-finding question.
preference_alignment: matches 'pursue all possible therapeutic options': YES on the advocate's reading, and this is the row where the two readings of that sentence collide. matches prefers_trials (true): YES, and it is the only open seat a treatment-naive chondrosarcoma patient is not automatically outside. No toxicity veto to hit; travel tolerance was never elicited.
guideline_status: None. Investigational, phase 1, no guideline position exists or could exist.
rationale_summary: The advocate and the risktaker ranked the same protocol for different things, and the difference decides the row. The risktaker ranked the drug at 2; the advocate ranked the phone call at 4, and concensusite endorsed the advocate's version explicitly, conceding that a pending IDH result does not gate this protocol and that NCT05039801 deserved a place on her own slate. The critic dissented against the risktaker's rank and qualified the advocate's, on the same ground both times: one cell-line paper showing grade-linked glutaminase expression (p=0.001, pmid:29576625), no in-vivo chondrosarcoma arm, and no clinical result for the class in this disease. So the ranked action here is the screening answer, not the drug, and the status carries the caveat above the mechanical score because the evidence underneath is preclinical only. The conservative's broader objection applies too: everything below first-line chemotherapy on the risktaker's slate carries zero chondrosarcoma clinical results, and this is one of them.
open_questions: Whether the site will screen a treatment-naive patient before first-line chemotherapy, and what the current escalation dose level is.
Her measured ECOG, which decides eligibility outright.
Whether she would choose a dose-finding slot over first-line anthracycline once she has heard both sets of numbers; nobody has asked her.
likelihood_of_effect: Low: no glutaminase inhibitor has a published response in any chondrosarcoma patient; support is grade-linked expression in cell lines (pmid:29576625) with no in-vivo arm.
toxicity_burden: Unknown (phase 1 escalation; no published grade 3+ profile in any chondrosarcoma patient, and adverse-event incidence is the trial's primary endpoint)

counter_productive_moa.description: Glutamine dependence inferred from grade-linked expression in cell lines; no in-vivo chondrosarcoma arm confirms the axis.

overall: The one open protocol naming chondrosarcoma as its own treatment-naive population; what is ranked is the screening call, not a drug with any efficacy estimate.

intervention_label: Abemaciclib on NCT04040205 (CDK-pathway-altered bone and soft-tissue sarcoma), pre-positioned for the post-anthracycline line
expected_benefit: No CDK4/6 inhibitor has a published chondrosarcoma efficacy result. What the protocol offers is a seat where dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma is named as its own eligible histology, with CDKN2A/B loss qualifying as the biomarker and central Rb immunohistochemistry as a pre-specified gate rather than a local read.
key_risks: ECOG 0-1, stricter than most protocols in this screen, so fitness decides this one too.
Two untested gates stand in the way: a qualifying CDK-pathway alteration and Rb positivity by central IHC. The seat may simply not exist for her.
Single-arm phase 2, n=44 across a mixed sarcoma population; even a positive readout will not separate drug effect from having selected an indolent CDK-altered subset.
Class toxicity is diarrhoea, neutropenia and venous thromboembolism; no chondrosarcoma-specific adverse-event table exists in the dossier.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials (true): YES, and the 14-day post-surgical window is more forgiving than the usual 4 weeks if stabilisation goes ahead. matches 'pursue all possible options': YES as a sequencing bet that costs nothing now. Mismatch on fitness: ECOG 0-1 excludes her as currently assumed.
guideline_status: None. Investigational for this indication; abemaciclib is marketed but has no bone-sarcoma label.
rationale_summary: The critic and the risktaker landed on the same protocol from opposite directions, which is the strongest thing about the row. The risktaker ranked it on the biology, CDKN2A/B loss recurring in this subtype with palbociclib cutting intraosseous chondrosarcoma burden in vivo (pmid:30808351, pmid:18624751); the critic ranked it explicitly on process rather than signal, noting that the palbociclib work never reported CDKN2A status of its lines and carries a 2023 figure correction (pmid:36803557), so the biological case is inference. What survives both readings is the trial design: a registered pre-specified primary endpoint, central Rb IHC, dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma named on its own, and the biomarker gate applied before enrolment. Neither persona argued for delaying first-line treatment to chase it. The move now is the panel plus Rb IHC, because the biomarker gate cannot be cleared retroactively.
open_questions: Whether the pending panel returns a qualifying CDK-pathway alteration; chondrosarcoma genomes are often quiet beyond IDH.
Rb status by central IHC, which is not ordered.
Whether her measured ECOG clears 0-1 after first-line treatment and any stabilisation.
likelihood_of_effect: Low to unknown: no published chondrosarcoma efficacy for any CDK4/6 inhibitor; the case rests on preclinical work (pmid:30808351, pmid:18624751) plus a named-histology biomarker-gated seat.
toxicity_burden: Moderate (diarrhoea, neutropenia, venous thromboembolism - class profile; no chondrosarcoma-specific grade 3+ table in the dossier)

counter_productive_moa.description: CDK4/6 inhibition is cytostatic; Rb-null or CDK-independent clones keep cycling despite target engagement.

overall: The cleanest trial design in the screen, dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma named and central Rb IHC pre-specified, sitting behind three untested gates and an ECOG 0-1 bar.

intervention_label: Pembrolizumab monotherapy, second line, conditional on a TMB-high or MSI-high call
expected_benefit: The entire prospective checkpoint experience in this disease is 1 responder among 5 chondrosarcoma patients in SARC028 (pmid:28988646), in a bone cohort whose primary endpoint failed at 2 of 40, plus 1 PR of 5 pembrolizumab-treated in the five-centre retrospective cohort (pmid:37174084) and one case report of a CR sustained 24 months (pmid:36465334). A TMB-high call would make it on-label at ORR 29% (95% CI 21-39) in KEYNOTE-158 (pmid:32919526), an analysis whose ten tumour cohorts included no sarcoma.
key_risks: Grade 3 or worse in the SARC028 bone cohort: anaemia 14%, lymphopenia 12%, prolonged aPTT 10%, thrombocytopenia 7%; serious adverse events in 12%.
Immune-related serious events across the trial included adrenal insufficiency, pneumonitis and nephritis.
Chondrosarcoma is typically TMB-low, so the on-label route is a low-prior bet; TMB at or above 10 mut/Mb appears in about 3.9% of sarcomas.
All efficacy data are single-arm or retrospective, with no PFS estimate in this histology against which to schedule a second line.
preference_alignment: matches 'pursue all possible therapeutic options': PARTIAL - it is held in reserve rather than offered now. matches prefers_trials: NO, this is an off-label or tumour-agnostic-label route rather than a protocol seat. No toxicity veto to hit; the irAE profile is the best characterised of anything non-cytotoxic in the dossier.
guideline_status: Tumour-agnostic FDA approval for TMB-high (at or above 10 mut/Mb) and MSI-high solid tumours in previously treated disease. concensusite declined to rank any checkpoint route because MSI, TMB and PD-L1 are all untested and the tumour-agnostic label is what would carry it.
rationale_summary: Both the conservative and the critic ranked it fourth and both called their confidence low, for the same reason: the numbers everyone quotes are subgroups of four and five patients whose confidence intervals run from roughly nothing to roughly everything. The critic went further and refused the standard framing, since the SARC028 responder's subtype is never stated in the primary report and the attribution to dedifferentiated histology is secondhand in later sources. PD-L1 does no predictive work in either direction here: the one documented responder in the five-centre series was TPS 7%, CPS 8 and microsatellite-stable. The advocate qualified the conservative's row on a different axis, objecting that an assumed ECOG was being used to pre-decide monotherapy over the combination for her. If the panel returns TMB-high or MSI-high, this rec moves onto the tumour-agnostic label for previously treated disease; the approved route would then be re-filed with the standard-of-care options, and what remains here is the off-label question.
open_questions: TMB and MSI, both untested; the panel that answers them is the rank-1 order.
MMR IHC as the orthogonal read on the MSI call.
Whether PD-L1 on the dedifferentiated component would change anyone's decision, given that prevalence of 41-52% (pmid:27312065) is not response prediction.
likelihood_of_effect: Low: 1 response among 5 chondrosarcoma patients in SARC028 (pmid:28988646); the on-label TMB-high route is a low-prior bet in a typically TMB-low disease.
toxicity_burden: Low (anaemia 14%, lymphopenia 12%, prolonged aPTT 10%; immune-related pneumonitis, adrenal insufficiency and nephritis reported)

counter_productive_moa.description: Macrophage-dominant microenvironment; T-cell depletion accelerated growth in the rat model, so PD-1 release may not be the lever.

overall: Thin but genuine disease-specific signal with the best characterised safety of anything non-cytotoxic here; a TMB-high or MSI-high call moves it on-label.

intervention_label: TAPUR (NCT02693535): marketed targeted agents assigned by genomic match, pre-positioned for the line after first-line chemotherapy
expected_benefit: No efficacy estimate exists for this row. TAPUR is a basket of single-arm matched cohorts with no chondrosarcoma cohort result, so what it buys is protocol structure, marketed drugs with known toxicity management, and 181 US sites.
key_risks: Wholly conditional on the pending panel finding something actionable, which chondrosarcoma genomes often decline to do.
Any matched agent would be used outside its approved histology, so efficacy in this disease is unknown even where safety is well described.
The line criterion is soft rather than numeric, phrased as no longer benefiting from or having no available standard treatment, which realistically places it after first-line anthracycline.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials (true): YES as written, and the ECOG 0-2 bar is one of very few in this screen her assumed fitness clears. matches 'pursue all possible options': YES. No toxicity veto to hit; toxicity is whatever the matched agent carries.
guideline_status: ASCO-run registry protocol. No guideline endorsement of any specific match in this histology.
rationale_summary: The conservative and the advocate both put it last on their slates and both said the same thing about it: it adds protocol structure without adding uncharacterised toxicity. The critic qualified rather than dissented, and his qualification is the one to carry downstream, that this is an access decision carrying no efficacy estimate at all and nobody should read the NCT number as though it were data. Its practical virtue is the fitness bar, since ECOG 0-2 is among the handful in this screen she may clear as written. She should hear plainly that the seat may never materialise.
open_questions: Whether the panel returns an alteration matched to a marketed agent in the TAPUR catalogue.
Whether the site's reading of the line criterion admits a patient one line into treatment for a chemo-responsive histology.
likelihood_of_effect: Unquantified: a basket of single-arm matched cohorts with no chondrosarcoma cohort result. An access decision carrying no efficacy estimate.
toxicity_burden: Unknown (agent assigned by genomic match; toxicity is whatever the matched marketed drug carries)

counter_productive_moa.description: No mechanism named until a match exists; the risk is second-line time spent on a search that finds nothing.

overall: An ECOG 0-2 protocol seat she may clear as written, wholly conditional on a panel that chondrosarcoma genomes often decline to fill.

intervention_label: Sunitinib plus nivolumab, off-label at first progression
expected_benefit: One partial response among the 4 dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma patients in IMMUNOSARC, inside a 40-patient bone cohort with 6-month PFS of 42% (95% CI 27-58) and overall ORR of 5% (pmid:39540661). Both drugs are marketed, so this needs no protocol seat.
key_risks: One treatment-related grade 5 pneumonitis among 40 patients, and 17% discontinued for toxicity.
Grade 3 or worse: neutropenia 15%, hypertension 15%, anaemia 12.5%, transaminase elevation 12.5%.
Median PFS 3.8 months and ORR 5% overall; the 42% six-month figure is largely stable disease in a mixed-histology cohort.
Off-label combination, so a payer fight should be expected.
preference_alignment: matches 'pursue all possible therapeutic options': YES on the risktaker's reading. matches prefers_trials: NO, the trial is closed and this would be off-label prescribing. No toxicity veto to hit, because the veto list is empty and inferred, which is exactly the conservative's objection: an empty list is not consent to a grade 5 risk she has never been shown.
guideline_status: Unendorsed. concensusite called it the clearest off-label move on the board and dissented on guideline-fit grounds, adding that marketed means buyable rather than endorsed.
rationale_summary: This is the sharpest split on the board. The risktaker ranked it third as the one checkpoint dataset where a dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma actually responded, with PD-L1 confined to her subtype at 9 of 22 positive against 0 of 119 conventional (pmid:27312065). Two personas dissented and a third piled on. The critic's objection was that a 1-of-4 subgroup is not a rank-3 argument in a patient whose fitness is an assumption, in a cohort that logged a treatment-related grade 5 pneumonitis. concensusite dissented on guideline fit and said that if a checkpoint route stays on the table at all, the conservative's biomarker-conditional monotherapy is the version a label could stand behind. The dossier's own microenvironment rows point away from the axis: macrophages dominate, a high CD68+/CD8+ ratio was independently prognostic at p<0.01 (pmid:31956474), and depleting T cells accelerated growth in the immunocompetent rat model (pmid:28344871). It stays in the table rather than disappearing because the risktaker's reading of her stated preference is a real reading, and she should see what was considered and rejected.
open_questions: Whether the one dedifferentiated responder in IMMUNOSARC differed from the other three in any measured way; the report does not say.
Whether her measured ECOG and organ function would tolerate a combination with a 17% toxicity discontinuation rate.
Payer position on an unendorsed off-label combination.
likelihood_of_effect: Low: 1 PR among 4 dedifferentiated patients and 5% ORR overall in IMMUNOSARC (pmid:39540661); the microenvironment evidence argues against the axis.
toxicity_burden: High (one treatment-related grade 5 pneumonitis; neutropenia 15%, hypertension 15%, transaminitis 12.5%, 17% discontinued for toxicity)

counter_productive_moa.description: T-cell depletion accelerated growth in the rat model; PD-1 release may favour the dominant macrophage compartment.

overall: The only checkpoint dataset in which a dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma responded, bought with a treatment-related grade 5 pneumonitis and a microenvironment that argues against the axis.

intervention_label: CD276 (B7-H3) CAR-T on NCT04433221, conditional on a high B7-H3 H-score
expected_benefit: No chondrosarcoma patient has received any B7-H3 agent with a published result. B7-H3 CAR-T regressed established osteosarcoma and Ewing xenografts where antigen density was high (pmid:30655315), and 96% of dedifferentiated chondrosarcomas express the antigen (pmid:33912442).
key_risks: Density is the operative quantity, not prevalence: chondrosarcoma's median H-score of 60 is the lowest of any sarcoma subtype against 175 for osteosarcoma, in the only H-score measurement that exists (n=133, pmid:42251292).
The protocol gives the CAR alongside low-dose chemotherapy and an irradiated tumour-cell vaccine, n=20, one site, safety as the primary endpoint, so a response could not be attributed to the CAR.
Rapidly progressing disease is excluded and lymphodepletion needs fitness nobody has measured.
Manufacturing time competes with a tumour that moves in weeks, and the site is in Shenzhen.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials (true): YES, and the Karnofsky 50% bar with no prior-therapy requirement is the loosest fitness criterion in the screen. matches 'pursue all possible options': YES on the risktaker's reading, NO on the advocate's, who left every antigen-directed platform off her slate rather than hand her a hopeful-sounding list.
guideline_status: None. Investigational cell therapy, single-site phase 1/2.
rationale_summary: The risktaker ranked it fifth and made the condition explicit: order the B7-H3 IHC with an H-score, pursue only if she reads high, drop it at the median without regret. The critic dissented and the substance of that dissent is what puts this row below the ranked options. The 96% figure is prevalence off a 24-specimen tissue microarray with a Merck-employed author (pmid:33912442), and both the CAR and the ADC literature make efficacy a function of antigen density: activity was greatly diminished against low-expressing targets (pmid:30655315) and functional avidity sets a measurable density threshold (pmid:40764385). The one H-score measurement in existence predicts her stated condition will most likely fail. The advocate left the whole antigen-directed class off her slate because every reachable protocol fails her today on line, histology or fitness. Surfaced rather than ranked, because the condition is one uncalibrated stain that nobody has ordered.
open_questions: B7-H3 IHC with an H-score on the dedifferentiated component; no target_validator row exists for this stain, which is itself the finding, since it is not a standard clinical order.
Whether the site would accept a patient with metastatic disease moving at this pace, given the rapid-progression exclusion.
likelihood_of_effect: Low: prior is against her, since chondrosarcoma's median B7-H3 H-score of 60 is the lowest of any sarcoma subtype (pmid:42251292) and efficacy is density-dependent.
toxicity_burden: Unknown (no published chondrosarcoma CAR-T safety data; class risks are cytokine release syndrome, neurotoxicity and lymphodepletion cytopenias)

counter_productive_moa.description: Below-threshold B7-H3 density gives sub-lytic CAR engagement and antigen-loss escape rather than tumour control.

overall: The antigen is near-universal but the density is not, and the trial pairs the CAR with chemotherapy and a vaccine, so even a response could not be attributed to it.

intervention_label: B7-H3-directed antibody-drug conjugates as a class (ifinatamab deruxtecan, HS-20093, MGC026, risvutatug rezetecan)
expected_benefit: No chondrosarcoma clinical result exists for any agent in the class. The mechanistic argument is a DXd payload with documented bystander killing of antigen-negative cells (pmid:27166974), which is what would matter in a tumour whose B7-H3 expression is heterogeneous and low-density.
key_risks: Every reachable protocol requires progression on or refractoriness to standard therapy and ECOG 0-1, both of which a treatment-naive patient with an assumed ECOG of 2 fails today.
Antigen density is the same problem as for the CAR: chondrosarcoma sits lowest of any sarcoma subtype at a median H-score of 60 (pmid:42251292).
DXd-class interstitial lung disease is a labelled risk of this payload family, in a patient with bilateral pulmonary nodules.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials (true): YES in principle, NO in practice; no arm accepts her today on line and fitness.
guideline_status: None. Investigational across the class.
rationale_summary: Nobody on the board ranked the ADC arm of the B7-H3 pipeline, and the advocate explained why in her round-1 notes: every reachable protocol fails her today on line, histology or fitness, and several have zero chondrosarcoma clinical results. It is surfaced here so the reader sees that the B7-H3 idea is not a single-sponsor bet and that four separate programmes were checked. The class re-opens as a real question after first-line progression, if a B7-H3 H-score is measured and reads high and her performance status clears 0-1.
open_questions: B7-H3 IHC with H-score, unordered.
Whether the IDeate-PanTumor01 sarcoma stratum reports any cartilage-tumour patients when it matures.
likelihood_of_effect: Unquantified in this disease: sarcoma strata exist in the pan-tumour programmes (pmid:41926962) but no chondrosarcoma efficacy has been reported for any B7-H3 ADC.
toxicity_burden: Unknown for this histology (no chondrosarcoma exposure; the DXd payload class carries interstitial lung disease and cytopenias)

counter_productive_moa.description: Low, heterogeneous B7-H3 density limits payload delivery; bystander killing is the only mechanism that partly offsets it.

overall: Four separate B7-H3 ADC programmes, none of which accepts a treatment-naive patient with an assumed ECOG of 2, and none with a chondrosarcoma result.

intervention_label: Ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd, DS-7300a) on IDeate-PanTumor01 (NCT04145622)
expected_benefit: No chondrosarcoma efficacy reported. Assessed at the class level in the b7h3-adc row above.
key_risks: Line-of-therapy and fitness criteria exclude her today.
Antigen density in chondrosarcoma is the lowest of any sarcoma subtype (pmid:42251292).
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials: YES in principle; not enrollable as written today.
guideline_status: None. Investigational.
rationale_summary: Sarcoma is one of the ten tumour types this pan-tumour protocol enrolls and the trial does not require a B7-H3 IHC result to enter, so a negative or absent stain would not itself exclude her later. Refractoriness to standard treatment and ECOG 0-1 do exclude her today, on both counts.
open_questions: B7-H3 IHC with H-score, unordered.
Whether entry criteria loosen after first-line progression.
likelihood_of_effect: Consolidated under the B7-H3 ADC class row; no product-specific chondrosarcoma estimate exists.
toxicity_burden: Unknown for this histology (no chondrosarcoma exposure)

counter_productive_moa.description: Same antigen-density ceiling as the class: low B7-H3 expression limits payload delivery.

overall: Sarcoma-inclusive and no IHC entry requirement, but refractory disease and ECOG 0-1 close it to a treatment-naive patient.

Prior systemic therapy in the recurrent or metastatic setting is mandatory, which a treatment-naive patient does not have.
IDH2 mutations are less frequent than IDH1 in cartilage tumours, so this is a contingency rather than an expected path.

Whether the site would consider an out-of-region primary under a protocol amendment.

intervention_label: Olaparib plus ceralasertib (AZD6738) in IDH-mutant solid tumours, NCT03878095
expected_benefit: None reported. The mechanism rides the IDH mutation rather than inhibiting it, on the argument that 2-HG accumulation produces a homologous-recombination defect that PARP and ATR inhibition exploit.
key_risks: Accrual has closed, ECOG 0-1 is required, progression despite standard therapy is required, and serial biopsies are mandatory unless waived.
The chondrosarcoma preclinical work argues against the premise.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials: moot; accrual closed.
guideline_status: None. Investigational combination.
rationale_summary: The one preclinical row in this dossier that tested the premise directly found against it: talazoparib sensitivity varied widely across chondrosarcoma lines and did not sort by IDH1 or IDH2 status, and long-term normalisation of D-2-HG did not create synthetic lethality (pmid:31810230). Kept because an IDH-mutant result would revive the mechanistic argument in other hands, not because the current evidence supports it. Accrual has closed regardless.
open_questions: Whether any open IDH-mutant PARP or ATR protocol accepts bone sarcoma.
likelihood_of_effect: Low: the chondrosarcoma-specific preclinical test of this premise was negative (pmid:31810230), and the trial is closed to accrual.
toxicity_burden: Unknown for this histology (NCT03878095 results unpublished; no chondrosarcoma safety readout)

counter_productive_moa.description: Talazoparib sensitivity did not sort by IDH status and D-2-HG normalisation produced no synthetic lethality.

overall: The synthetic-lethality premise was tested in chondrosarcoma lines and failed; the trial is closed to accrual besides.

intervention_label: PD-1 / PD-L1 checkpoint blockade as a class (nivolumab, envafolimab and others)
expected_benefit: Assessed at the agent level in the pembrolizumab row above. PD-L1 sits in the dedifferentiated component, positive in 9 of 22 dedifferentiated tumours against 0 of 119 conventional (pmid:27312065), and the subtype carries high TIL, HLA and checkpoint expression (pmid:33912442).
key_risks: Prevalence is not response prediction.
The class shares the pembrolizumab toxicity profile.
The two first-line sarcoma chemo-immunotherapy protocols screened (NCT06422806, NCT07243626) exclude chondrosarcoma, the second by name.
preference_alignment: matches prefers_trials: NO as a class; no open first-line sarcoma chemo-immunotherapy protocol admits cartilage histology.
guideline_status: No guideline position in chondrosarcoma. concensusite declined to rank any checkpoint route because MSI, TMB and PD-L1 are all untested.
rationale_summary: Consolidated under the ranked pembrolizumab row, which is the version of this class a label could carry. Recorded separately so the reader sees that the first-line sarcoma chemo-immunotherapy protocols were screened and that both carve out cartilage tumours, NCT07243626 naming chondrosarcoma in exclusion criterion 1. That pattern repeats across the class and is worth stating once so the same trials are not rediscovered downstream.
open_questions: PD-L1 IHC on the dedifferentiated component with the clone and scoring system recorded.

overall: The first-line sarcoma chemo-immunotherapy protocols all carve out cartilage histology; the label-carrying version of this class is the ranked pembrolizumab row.

intervention_label: Mifamurtide (MEPACT) with doxorubicin, macrophage-directed therapy
expected_benefit: No human chondrosarcoma exposure. Mifamurtide increased chemosensitivity in CH2879/THP-1 spheroids and improved antitumour efficacy with doxorubicin in the CH2879 xenograft (pmid:40960554).
key_risks: The EMA label is paediatric osteosarcoma and there is no US route, which is what kept it off the risktaker's slate.
No clinical safety data in this disease or this age group for the combination.
preference_alignment: matches 'pursue all possible therapeutic options': YES in spirit, blocked by access rather than by evidence.
guideline_status: EMA-approved for high-grade resectable non-metastatic osteosarcoma in children and young adults; no chondrosarcoma indication and no US approval.
rationale_summary: The risktaker's round-1 notes record that this nearly took rank 5 and lost on access rather than on mechanism: it is the best fit in the dossier to a macrophage-dominant microenvironment, where CD163+ macrophage depletion slowed growth in the immunocompetent rat model (pmid:28344871) and a high CD68+/CD8+ ratio was independently prognostic (pmid:31956474). Surfaced rather than ranked because the evidence is a xenograft combination and the drug has no route to her.
open_questions: Whether a named-patient import route exists in her jurisdiction, which was never established because no geography band was elicited.
likelihood_of_effect: Unquantified: one xenograft combination study (pmid:40960554) and no human chondrosarcoma exposure, against the best mechanistic fit in the dossier.
toxicity_burden: Unknown for this histology (no human chondrosarcoma exposure; evidence is a xenograft combination with doxorubicin)

counter_productive_moa.description: Broad myeloid activation is untested here; the rat data support CD163+ depletion, not indiscriminate macrophage stimulation.

overall: Mechanistically the best fit to this tumour's macrophage-dominant microenvironment, and the row that lost on access rather than on biology.

Off-label use of a drug approved in a different disease setting, with no biomarker to select on.

If EPAS1 amplification turns up on the rank-1 panel the argument gets sharper, which is worth stating on the requisition.
open_questions: Whether the comprehensive panel reports EPAS1 copy number.
Whether any open belzutifan basket accepts sarcoma.

toxicity_burden: Unknown for this histology (no chondrosarcoma exposure; evidence is xenograft knockdown)

counter_productive_moa.description: No plausible counter-productive vector identified; the limit is absent clinical evidence, not mechanism.

overall: A real target with knockdown evidence and no clinical result, surfaced so the reader sees it was considered rather than missed.

intervention_label: Proton beam or carbon-ion radiotherapy to the acetabular lesion (NCT02838602, NCT05033288)
expected_benefit: In the pelvic comparison, carbon-ion radiotherapy and surgery gave no survival difference with better musculoskeletal function after carbon ions (n=31, p=0.03 on function, p=0.347 on OS; pmid:26150259). Both figures come from non-metastatic curative-intent cohorts, so they do not transfer to her.
key_risks: Periacetabular late toxicity in survivors: neurological deficit 52%, pelvic insufficiency fracture 48%, femoral head necrosis 37%, with periacetabular tumours at higher risk (p=0.018; pmid:32658315). The denominator counts survivors only, which is a best-case denominator.
Irradiated bone formed atrophic non-unions in the rat femoral-fracture model (pmid:23606416), which argues against radiating a fractured pelvis before the fixation question is settled.
Both protocol routes exclude distant metastases (NCT02838602, NCT05033288), so neither accepts her.
The pooled proton meta-analysis reports 5-year OS of 99% with a confidence interval of 98-101, which is a broken pooling model; the critic refused to quote effect estimates out of it.
preference_alignment: matches 'pursue all possible therapeutic options': the board judged NO on this one, unanimously. Travel tolerance and self-payment were never discussed with her, and no operating US carbon-ion facility was verified.
guideline_status: Particle therapy has a place in unresectable non-metastatic chondrosarcoma. concensusite's judgement was off-population rather than off-guideline, and she said she would not fight an insurer for it here.
rationale_summary: All five personas declined this independently in their round-1 notes, which is the only unanimous rejection on the board, and none of them filed it as a formal veto row. Their reasons converged: the local-control case comes from skull-base, low-to-intermediate-grade, non-metastatic cohorts (pmid:40889733); the toxicity ledger lands hardest in exactly her anatomy on a pelvis that has already fractured; and both particle protocols exclude distant metastases. The conservative and concensusite added the sequencing constraint that any radiotherapy to that bone waits until fixation is settled, on the atrophic non-union mechanism (pmid:23606416). Kept in the table with status not_recommended so the reader can see what was considered and rejected rather than inferring it was never examined.
open_questions: Whether palliative rather than curative-intent radiotherapy to the fracture site has a role after fixation; that option is assessed on the Standard-of-care table on this page.
Her travel tolerance and willingness to self-pay, neither ever discussed.
likelihood_of_effect: Low for her situation: the local-control figures come from skull-base, non-metastatic, curative-intent cohorts (pmid:40889733), and both particle protocols exclude distant metastases.
toxicity_burden: High (neurological deficit 52%, pelvic insufficiency fracture 48%, femoral head necrosis 37% among periacetabular survivors)

counter_productive_moa.description: Irradiating a fractured, unfixed pelvis produced atrophic non-union in the rat model; local control bought at structural cost.

overall: The one option all five personas declined independently: the toxicity ledger lands hardest in exactly her anatomy, and both protocols exclude metastatic disease.
